const enabled = true;
const title = "Demo";

export const View = (
  <>
    {/* This fragment-level expression comment should wrap as a standalone JSX expression comment. */}
    <section aria-label={/* This attribute comment stays inline because expression text appears after it even when it is long. */ title}>
      <span>{/* This leading logical expression comment stays inline because expression text follows it. */ enabled && value}</span>
      <span>{enabled && value /* This logical expression trailing comment should move before the expression when it wraps. */}</span>
      <span>{enabled ? value /* This conditional expression inline comment should stay inline because expression text appears on both sides. */ : fallback}</span>
      <span>{items.map((item) => <strong>{item.label /* This nested JSX expression comment should wrap in the nested container. */}</strong>)}</span>
    </section>
  </>
);
